  "phoneNote": "The hero section has a large empty gap between the text links and the arched photos, and the booking note under the opening hours is duplicated.",
  "desktopNote": "The editorial layout with arched photos and a visual schedule bar looks distinctive and well-crafted, marred only by the duplicated sentence below the opening hours.",

  "fixes": [
    "Remove the duplicate sentence 'Brez naročila težko pridete na vrsto, zato raje pokličite.' at the bottom of the 'Kdaj smo odprti' section.",
    "Tighten the vertical gap between the hero action links ('Naročite se po telefonu' / 'Poglejte cenik') and the three arched photos on mobile, and place those two links side by side.",
    "Convert the 'Kako poteka obisk' timeline into a three-column horizontal row on desktop so it doesn't leave the right half of the screen empty."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On both phone and desktop, the sentence 'Brez naročila težko pridete na vrsto, zato raje pokličite.' is repeated twice in a row at the bottom of the 'Kdaj smo odprti' section."
  ]
}
